provenance.notes: Trees with data_kind 'simulated' are gpu_stack heatwave simulator v2 output. Hardware: Google Colab CPU runtime, High-RAM shape, 8 vCPU, Python 3.13. Quantile levels are adjusted one at a time (approximation).

protocol.mint_covariance: Schaefer-Strimmer shrinkage of base-median errors on training windows (steps 1-10, or all steps for mint_shrink_allh); simulated trees: validation seeds, calibration windows disjoint in time from the test windows
protocol.quantile_adjustment: each of the 21 quantile levels adjusted separately with the same G (approximation); median = level 0.5
protocol.coherence_error: sum |y_A - sum of bottom series below A| / sum |y_A| per aggregate level, pooled over windows, steps, nodes; quantile entries per level
protocol.metrics: as multiscale.json; level-wise WQL = 2*mean pinball/mean|y| over the nodes of the level; MASE with in-context naive (lag 1) scale

bootstrap.unit: windows (origins); group = session or sim seed

protocol.classical: seasonal-naive (season 1 = last value), AutoETS (shared, unrestricted), AutoETS restricted to additive error and no trend (ets-flat), ARIMA(2,1,1)
protocol.timestral: zero-shot 5M and 28M; 209M not run in this study
